explanation: A ritual washing with water that symbolizes cleansing from sin and consecration to a new way of life, performed by John the Baptist in preparation for the coming of the Messiah.
The concept of turning back to God by changing one's mindset and behavior after acknowledging one's sins.
God's rule or dominion that John announced was near, which required an immediate response from the people.
Clothing made of coarse camel hair that John the Baptist wore to signal asceticism and a life of simplicity in the wilderness.
A symbol of Jesus Christ as God's sacrificial lamb, whose blood will take away the sin of the world according to the prophecies John referred to.
The concept of inner cleansing and power that God gives through the Holy Spirit, which John said he himself was not worthy to perform for Jesus' sake.
